title: Tribunus Service-Level Indicators and Alert Classification
description: SLI definitions for every production service, plus the three-tier alert classification system.

availability.measurement: uptime / (uptime + downtime) over the measurement window
availability.target: 99.9% monthly for core services (coordination, session, tool, provider)

latency.measurement: p50, p95, p99 of request duration in milliseconds

error_rate.measurement: failed_requests / total_requests over the measurement window
error_rate.classification: Uses failure_classification taxonomy (introduced_regression, pre_existing_failure, infrastructure_failure, flaky_test, resource_exhaustion, invalid_test_assumption)

throughput.measurement: requests per second averaged over 1-minute windows

critical.description: Service is down or severely degraded. User-visible impact is immediate.
critical.response: Immediate human response required. Paging or on-call escalation.

warning.description: Service is degraded but not down. User impact may be partial or delayed.
warning.response: Investigation required within business hours. Automated ticket created.

info.description: Notable but non-urgent condition. No user impact expected.
info.response: Acknowledge within 1 week. Review in weekly ops review.
